scenario_description:
A slow sink alone never produces a 429, because the shard loop never blocks on a sink. It sheds at the sink queue, counts every drop, and the accounting identity stays exact. INVARIANTS.md I3, I4 and the accounting identity in SCALE.md, and the observation in SCALE.md: with a sink sleeping 50 ms per event, ten thousand events got a hundred replies of 202 and the sink dropped 8,998 of them.
The harness makes the ntfy sink slow before the flood. That control is an in-process method call on the sink receiver, not an HTTP endpoint, so the code under test cannot reach it.
